text:
maya: FYI, started seeing repeated ECC correctable bursts on rack3 around 2026-03-17 02:01 UTC. Affected nodes: rack3-n02, rack3-n04, rack3-n07. Latency spikes and ~5m degraded SLOs.

alex: can you paste dmesg + nvidia-smi output?

maya: sure — trimmed snippet from rack3-n02: 
```
[Mar 17 02:01:10] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 31, PID: 2213
[Mar 17 02:01:11] kernel: ECC: Correctable error on GPU 0
nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY shows corrected ECC count: 1200 -> 1450 over 10min
```

chris: that's high. Any commonalities? same firmware/hw revision?

sam: all three report BIOS/fw 525.85.12 and vendor batch code BATCH-117 (sticker on chassis). We saw a smaller wave last month but it was sparse.

julia: vendor flagged a suspected manufacturing lot variance for BATCH-117 last week. They've acknowledged multiple reports but no RMA ETA yet. cc @vendor-ops

oncall-bot: [alert] ECC-correctable-spike detected on rack3 (severity: medium). Auto-escalation scheduled at 02:15 UTC if pattern persists.

alex: could be thermal + power interplay. Any fan/power logs? We had a regression when power capping was turned off in Feb.

maya: fan curves look normal. Power draw spiking to ~320W under peak -> temps transiently hit 83C. Quick inline histogram correlating corrected ECC vs temp:
```
GPU0 temps: 72,78,80,83,79
ECC counts delta: 0,10,45,200,50
```

chris: that correlation is suspicious (temp spike -> big ECC delta). Action plan proposal: 
- Drain the three nodes (`sudo drain-node rack3-n02` + migrate running jobs)
- Run memory stress + memtest under controlled power cap 300W and flash newer FW 526.38 on test node
- If errors persist on the same serials -> initiate RMA for that lot
- Schedule a maintenance window tonight 00:00-06:00 UTC. Estimated impact: ~6% capacity for ~6h (migrated jobs + tests)

sam: +1. I'll handle job migrations and collect full serials & sticker photos.

julia: I'll open a vendor escalation ticket and push for priority RMA citing repeated wave and the BATCH-117 lot.

maya: assigning: sam -> drain + job migrations, julia -> vendor escalation & RMA, alex -> FW validation & test image. I'll monitor alerts and post updates here.

alex: one more ask: grab full `nvidia-smi -q` for all affected nodes and snapshot `dmesg`. I'll prepare a playbook to flash 526.38 and a rollback plan (reimage to golden if flash fails).

maya: noted. If vendor delays >72h we'll rotate in spares from rack5 temporarily to keep prod capacity.

chris: draft hypothesis for RCA: "manufacturing lot (BATCH-117) + elevated transient temps -> correctable ECC bursts -> transient inference degradation and latency spikes." We'll expand after test results.

maya: will create formal postmortem doc after RMA/tests. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
